To buy **Salesforce** stock (NYSE: **CRM** ), you'll need to go through a standard stock brokerage account.

### 1. Quick Snapshot of Salesforce (CRM)

- **Ticker Symbol:** `CRM` on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE)
- **Consensus Rating:** Generally rated a **Buy** by Wall Street analysts
- **Recent Context:** Analysts highlight growth drivers like Agentforce and Data Cloud/ARR, alongside ongoing AI agent expansions and strategic integrations. *(Note: Market prices fluctuate constantly; check your broker for real-time pricing).* [[1]](https://public.com/stocks/crm/forecast-price-target)[[2]](https://www.fool.com/investing/how-to-invest/stocks/how-to-invest-in-salesforce-stock/)

### 2. Steps to Buy CRM Stock

1. **Choose or Open a Brokerage Account:**   
If you don't have an investment account yet, you can open one with popular retail platforms (such as Fidelity, Charles Schwab, E*TRADE, Robinhood, or Vanguard).
2. **Deposit Funds:**   
Transfer cash from your bank account into your brokerage balance.
3. **Search for the Ticker:**   
Type **`CRM`** into your broker's search or quote bar.[[1]](https://www.fool.com/investing/how-to-invest/stocks/how-to-invest-in-salesforce-stock/)
4. **Choose Your Order Type:** 
	- **Market Order:** Buys the shares immediately at the current best available price.
	- **Limit Order:** Sets a specific maximum price you are willing to pay per share.[[1]](https://www.fool.com/investing/how-to-invest/stocks/how-to-invest-in-salesforce-stock/)
5. **Set the Quantity & Submit:**   
Decide how many shares (or dollar amount, if your broker supports fractional shares) you want to purchase, review the order details, and hit **Buy**.[[1]](https://www.fool.com/investing/how-to-invest/stocks/how-to-invest-in-salesforce-stock/)

*Disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes and does not constitute formal financial or investment advice.*
